nodes_to_add.name: Build Final Public Payload
nodes_to_add.position_hint: between Normalize Run Output and Final Surface Strict Scan
js_responsibilities: Read normalized run item (outline, seo_strategy, generated_text, seoqa, factcheck, flags, task_id, brief)
Detect NL strict trigger phrases in brief; set meta.strict_surface_requested and meta.effective_strict_surface_gate
Parse custom NL banned words into meta.custom_task_markers[] (task-scoped only; do not mutate central SOT)
Build public_payload.surfaces (seo_tz, seo_strategy_public, seo_text, seo_qa_public, factcheck_public, tables_summary)
Apply HIDE_RAW_STRATEGY_JSON: seo_strategy_public = human summary bullets only (headings, table titles, intent); no JSON.stringify(table_strategy)
Set seo_qa_public.include_summary and factcheck_public.include_summary as candidate true (subject to scan)
Build telegram.parts_preview via lightweight compose (same section order as Format Run Pipeline will use)
Store internal_raw (seo_strategy_raw, seoqa_raw, factcheck_raw, normalize_run_output ref)
Initialize meta.strict_surface_status=pending, meta.repair_attempts=0
Pass through lock/task routing fields unchanged for PC-07

nodes_to_add.name: Final Surface Strict Scan
js_responsibilities: Embed central STRICT_MARKER_SOT v1 (shared snippet; see data-contracts)
Merge meta.custom_task_markers into scan list for this task only
Walk all public_payload.surfaces + telegram.parts_preview strings
Emit strict_surface_scan { verdict, count, residuals[], surfaces_scanned[], blocked, version }
Set meta.strict_surface_status = clean | dirty
Never mutate surface text in scan node (detect only)

nodes_to_add.name: Build Strict Surface Repair Payload
js_responsibilities: Increment meta.repair_attempts (must stay <= max_repair_attempts)
Build OpenRouter chat payload mirroring Run Text Repair / Run SEO QA pattern
Include strict_marker_sot, residuals[], public_payload.surfaces (repairable only), protected_fields list
System prompt: rewrite ONLY listed field paths; preserve task_id, headings, entities, table rows/columns; no new claims
Request JSON response matching repair_response contract
Set skip_http=true flag when harness offline mode

nodes_to_add.name: Run Strict Surface Repair
nodes_to_add.model_reference: match Run Text Repair or Run SEO QA (openai/gpt-4.1-mini via OpenRouter)

nodes_to_add.name: Extract Strict Surface Repair
js_responsibilities: Parse OpenRouter response JSON from repair LLM
Validate repair_response schema
Merge repaired_surfaces into public_payload only at allowed field paths
Preserve protected_fields (task_id, mode, chat_id, lock fields, table structure keys)
Rebuild telegram.parts_preview after merge
On parse failure: set meta.strict_surface_status=dirty, repair_error=unparseable

nodes_to_add.name: Final Surface Strict Re-Scan
js_responsibilities: Re-run identical scan logic as Final Surface Strict Scan (duplicate SOT snippet)
Emit strict_surface_rescan with same contract shape
Update meta.strict_surface_status

nodes_to_add.name: Format Strict Reject Message
js_responsibilities: Build single telegram part: STRICT QA REJECT — output blocked before final send
Include task_id, residual_count, per-residual surface/family/field_path/snippet (max 5 snippets)
Set memory_status=blocked_dirty, strict_surface_status=blocked_dirty
Set public_payload=null for approved send; attach blocked_diagnostic object
Produce telegram_parts array compatible with Take First Item / Parse Mode (one short part)
Do NOT include full SEO text, raw Strategy JSON, or polluted QA summary

Remove JSON.stringify(seoStrategy.table_strategy) dump from default Telegram output

Include factcheck_public.summary only when include_summary === true
Set meta.memory_status on output: approved_clean when strict_surface_status=clean and repair_attempts=0; repair_attempted_clean when repair_attempts>=1 and rescan clean
When public_payload absent (legacy partial runs / outline-only shortcuts): preserve existing behavior for sandbox safety
Do NOT re-run strict scan or invent new free-text blocks after gate

nodes_to_modify.name: Prepare Memory Row Run
